title: About the security content of Safari 9.0.2

others: This document describes the security content of Safari 9.0.2.
Where possible, CVE IDs are used to reference the vulnerabilities for further information.

available_for: OS X Mavericks v10.9.5, OS X Yosemite v10.10.5, and OS X El Capitan v10.11.2
impact: Visiting a maliciously crafted website may lead to arbitrary code execution
description:
Multiple memory corruption issues existed in WebKit.
These issues were addressed through improved memory handling.

available_for: OS X Mavericks v10.9.5, OS X Yosemite v10.10.5, and OS X El Capitan v10.11.2
impact: Visiting a malicious website may lead to user interface spoofing
description: An issue existed in Safari's handling of URLs.
